import json
from driver import run

def A(states, inputs=[[[3]]], edges=[[0,"a",0]], start=0, fair=[], op="audit"):
    return run(json.dumps({"op":op,"inputs":inputs,"states":states,"edges":edges,
                  "start":start,"fairness":fair}))[0][0]

# empty rank set: sum must be the zero vector
r = A([{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}])
assert r == {"safe":True,"safety":None,"terminates":True,"liveness":None}
r = A([{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[],"sum":[0]}]}])
print("empty ranks, zero sum:", r)
r = A([{"delivered":[[3]], "slots":[]}])
print("delivered correct -> done+safe:", r)
# R=0 barrier world: every state done, no slots possible
r = A([{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}], inputs=[[]])
print("R=0 barrier (P=1):", r)
r = A([{"delivered":[[],[]],"slots":[]}], inputs=[[],[]])
print("R=0 barrier (P=2):", r)
r = A([{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[[]]],"slots":[]}],
      inputs=[[[ ]]], edges=[[0,"a",1]])
print("D=0 barrier single-step:", r)
# slot with empty ranks and nonzero sum -> unsafe
r = A([{"delivered":[[3]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[],"sum":[5]}]}])
print("empty ranks nonzero sum (start done, unsafe):", r["safe"], r["safety"])
# subset rank sums

                                   {"seq":0,"ranks":[1],"sum":[4]}]}],
      inputs=[[[3],[1]],[[4],[2]]])
